backups.created: Backup created and locally verified. Review recovery requirements before relying on it.
backups.failed: The backup failed; see the server log
backups.schedule_help: Choose a daily or weekly interval while GoRun is running. Retention counts locally verified copies only; partial, old-format and corrupt copies stay available for review. Keep recovery keys and external files separately.

backups.restore_help: Backups do not contain secret.key or gorun.toml by default: keep your own protected copy. Online: Inspect / Restore writes a confined copy under data/restores/<stamp>/ while the site keeps running. Offline: stop the service and run gorun backup-restore --input … --dest <new-directory-path> outside the data directory (the path must not exist). For a staging site or promote-to-live cutover use gorun staging seed|promote (docs/STAGING.md). Before serving a restore, move it out of the live data directory, copy the secrets, and stop every process on the old one. See docs/PRODUCTION.md.
backups.inspect_help: Preflight verifies the local pair (checksums, archive safety, database integrity). It does not prove live cutover or remote read-back.
backups.readiness.local_ok: Local pair verified — checksums and database integrity passed. Live cutover still needs the checklist below (secrets, themes, stopped writes, remote copy).
backups.readiness.review_required: Local pair usable — review the site-specific warnings below before cutover (for example external media or upload size limits).
backups.readiness.blocked: Blocked — fix the reported errors before restoring.
backups.cutover_help: These are expected recovery requirements, not local integrity failures. Keep secrets, matching theme folders, and external objects separately; stop writes when you need a fully consistent handoff.
backups.restore_title: Restore to a new data directory
backups.restore_confined_help: Restore writes only into the path below (a new directory path that must not already exist). It never overwrites the live data directory while this process holds the SQLite lock.
backups.restore_confirm: Restore this backup into a new directory under restores/? The live site keeps running. To switch over, move the restored folder out of the data directory, stop the site, and point --data at it.
backups.restore_already: A restore for this stamp is already present.
backups.restore_next: Move this folder out of the live data directory (for example next to it), copy secret.key and gorun.toml into it (or set the original GORUN_SECRET_KEY), stop every process using the old data directory, then start GoRun with --data pointing at the moved folder.
backups.restored: Backup restored into a new directory under restores/. Move it out of the live data directory, copy the secrets, stop the live process, then serve with --data on the moved folder.
backups.restore_exists: That restore directory already exists; remove or rename it before restoring again.
backups.restore_blocked: Restore blocked: the local pair failed preflight. See Inspect.
backups.restore_partial: An earlier restore was interrupted and left the partial directory below. Remove it with the button below, then restore again.
backups.restore_partial_clear_confirm: Permanently delete this leftover partial restore directory? You can restore again afterward.
backups.restore_partial_cleared: Partial restore directory removed. You can restore again.
backups.restore_partial_gone: No leftover partial directory was found for this stamp.
backups.restore_partial_clear_failed: Could not remove the partial restore directory; see the server log.
backups.restore_failed: Restore failed; see the server log and Inspect.
backups.busy: The data directory is busy with an update, backup or restore. Wait for it to finish and try again.

backups.code.pair_checksum_mismatch: A file no longer matches the checksum recorded in the manifest.
backups.code.stale_sqlite_sidecar: A leftover SQLite -wal or -shm file sits next to the backup database.
backups.code.archive_invalid_or_unsafe: The files archive is damaged or contains unsafe paths or links.
backups.code.database_unreadable: The backup database cannot be opened.
backups.code.database_close_failed: The backup database could not be closed cleanly.
backups.code.database_integrity_check_fa: The database integrity check could not run.
backups.code.database_integrity_failed: The database integrity check found corruption.
backups.code.foreign_key_check_failed: The foreign key check could not run.
backups.code.foreign_key_violations: The database has rows that point to missing records.
backups.code.external_reference_check_fa: Externally stored media could not be checked.
backups.code.encrypted_upload_limit_exce: A file is larger than the encrypted remote upload limit.
backups.code.external_media_required: Some media lives in external storage (S3) and is not in this archive.
backups.code.external_reference_invalid: Some external media references are invalid.
backups.code.independent_original_secret: This backup has no secret.key: you need the original key, kept separately.
backups.code.remote_pair_not_confirmed: No confirmed remote copy of this pair.
backups.code.remote_readback_not_verifie: Reading the remote copy back has not been verified.
backups.code.writes_must_stop_for_full_c: Database and files are not one transaction: stop writes for a fully consistent copy.

updates.confirm: I have reviewed the deployment source and have an off-host backup and the site secrets. Request the update now.

integrations.cloudflare.title: Cloudflare connection
integrations.cloudflare.intro: Paste a Cloudflare API token. GoRun stores it encrypted, never shows it again, and uses it only to list accounts, buckets, databases and Workers. It never creates, changes or deletes resources, and it is not an S3 credential or a GoRun Edge manager key.
integrations.cloudflare.token.help: Leave blank to keep the stored token.
integrations.cloudflare.account.placehol: 32-character account ID (after the first check the accounts are listed here)
integrations.cloudflare.account.help: When the token sees several accounts, choose the one that holds this site's resources.
integrations.cloudflare.account.incomple: The account list was not read in full; an account missing here can still be entered by ID.
integrations.cloudflare.clear.confirm: Remove the stored Cloudflare token and account selection? Bound buckets keep their own credentials.
integrations.cloudflare.scopes.title: Permission checks
integrations.cloudflare.scopes.dedicated: Create a dedicated token limited to one account with only these read permissions. GoRun cannot see permissions beyond the ones it checks, so a broader token is not detected as such.
integrations.cloudflare.scopes.not_s3: R2 buckets need their own S3 access key pair to be bound as storage; this token cannot read or write objects.
integrations.cloudflare.scopes.note: A verified token does not prove per-service permissions: each lamp is one bounded read of that service. Passed means the read succeeded; Incomplete means the token lacks it; Could not verify means the provider or network failed.
integrations.cloudflare.error.token: Enter a Cloudflare API token (letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores).
integrations.cloudflare.error.account: Enter a valid 32-character account ID, or select the account after the first check.
integrations.cloudflare.error.conflict: The Cloudflare settings changed while this request was running. Review the current settings and try again; this request saved no changes.
integrations.discovery.title: Discovered resources
integrations.discovery.intro: Inventory of the selected account, read in the background with full pagination. Nothing here is created or modified; D1 rows and bucket objects are never read. Resources are offered for explicit binding only.
integrations.discovery.needs_token: Store a Cloudflare token to discover resources.
integrations.discovery.needs_account: Select an account to discover its resources.
integrations.discovery.never: Not read yet. Press Refresh to queue the first read.
integrations.discovery.running: A read is queued or running. Reload in a moment.
integrations.discovery.empty: The account has no resources of this kind, or the token cannot list them.
integrations.discovery.note: A Worker is shown as a GoRun Edge instance only after its manager contract confirms it with a manager key; a name proves nothing. Discovery grants no access to the site: the Cloudflare token and the Edge manager key stay separate.
integrations.workers.key.help: Used once for this check and not stored. The Edge admin shows the primary manager key once.
integrations.workers.stale: Identity saved for an earlier configuration
integrations.workers.identified: The Worker answered the GoRun Edge manager contract; its identity was saved.

integrations.workers.error.worker: Select a Cloudflare account and a discovered Worker first.
integrations.workers.error.identify: The origin did not answer the GoRun Edge manager contract for this key.
integrations.storage.title: Storage and backup buckets
integrations.storage.intro: Media and backups can share one bucket because they never share a prefix: media objects live under the site's uploads prefix and encrypted backups under the backups prefix. Values below are resolved from their source; edit them where they live.
integrations.storage.probe.confirm: Queue one isolated probe object (written, read back and deleted) on this destination?
integrations.storage.probe.help: The read-only check proves the bucket is reachable with these keys. The probe writes one uniquely named object, reads it back and deletes it; it never runs a backup, touches real objects or changes retention, ACL or lifecycle. The probe needs the capability-test permission.
integrations.storage.probe.unavailable: No destination is bound for this purpose, or its profile is missing.
integrations.storage.source.help: R2 derives the endpoint from the selected Cloudflare account. Any other S3-compatible provider needs its https endpoint.
integrations.storage.credentials.help: Access key and secret of the bucket (for R2: an R2 API token's S3 credentials). The Cloudflare API token is not accepted here. Leave both blank to reuse the keys of an existing profile below.
integrations.storage.reuse: Reuse credentials of an existing S3 profile
integrations.storage.confirm_both: I understand media and backups will share this bucket under separate prefixes, and that the backup prefix must stay private.
integrations.storage.bound: The bucket was bound. A read-only check was queued; run the probe to verify writes.
integrations.storage.error.confirm: Confirm that one bucket will serve both purposes.

modules.title: Modules
modules.intro: Everything this build runs: built-in modules, core services and external extensions, with what each registered in this process, what it depends on, whether it is on, and whether it needs configuration. Activation is read at boot: a change here applies after a restart and never deletes data.
modules.saved: Saved for %s: restart the server to apply. Nothing was deleted.
modules.error.not_optional: This module cannot be switched here.
modules.error.not_found: No such module in this build.
modules.msg.pending_restart: The saved activation differs from the running one; restart gorun serve to apply it.
modules.msg.off_keeps_data: Off: no routes, API operations, jobs, crons, admin pages or hooks are registered. Its tables and settings are kept and read again when it is turned on.
modules.msg.parked_jobs: %d queued jobs are parked for this module and run after it is turned on again; nothing is lost.
modules.msg.dependency_off: Depends on %s, which is off: this module may not work until it is on.
modules.msg.if_off_affects: Turning this off also affects %s (see its row).
modules.dep.commerce.membership: Commerce is off: customer sign-in is unavailable; memberships, quotas and submission data are preserved and remain available to authenticated users.
modules.dep.commerce.saas: Commerce is off: customer sign-in is unavailable and subscription sync from Stripe stops; local SaaS grants keep working for authenticated users.
modules.dep.commerce.wpmigrate: Commerce is off: WooCommerce products are skipped during imports; posts, pages and media still import.
modules.dep.commerce.mcp: Commerce is off: the list_products tool is not offered to agents.
modules.dep.commerce.theme: Commerce is off: store pages (/shop, /cart, /account) are not served; themes render with empty product lists.
modules.dep.wpmigrate.mcp: WordPress migration is off: the migration tools are not offered to agents.
modules.desc.auth: Users, roles and permissions, sessions, CSRF, API keys, magic links and the admin shell.
modules.desc.content: Content types, custom fields, items, revisions, queries and the editor.
modules.desc.media: Uploads, local or S3-compatible storage, image variants and the media picker.
modules.desc.redirects: URL redirects served before the site router.
modules.desc.seo: Meta tags, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and SEO settings.
modules.desc.theme: Theme loading, template hierarchy, overrides, identity settings and the Appearance screens.
modules.desc.pattern: Site layout pattern plugins that add page layouts to themes.
modules.desc.builder: Starter sites, structured page layouts, site identity and readiness checks.
modules.desc.site: The public front controller, contact forms and submissions, private intake and page access.
modules.desc.api: Mounts every registered API operation and serves the OpenAPI document.
modules.desc.admin: Dashboard, users, roles, settings, health, jobs, backups, updates, integrations, canvases and the mail service.
modules.desc.webhooks: Outgoing webhooks: subscriptions, signed deliveries and retries.
modules.desc.commerce: Products, cart and checkout, orders, entitlements, Stripe and billing servers.
modules.desc.saas: SaaS apps, plans and subscriptions on top of the store.
modules.desc.membership: Member grants, plans, content quotas and submissions.
modules.desc.workagents: Work agents, their workflows and schedules.
modules.desc.wpmigrate: WordPress and WooCommerce import wizard, pipeline and validation report.
modules.desc.mcp: The Model Context Protocol server for agents and the approval queue.
modules.desc.ext: Installs external extensions and delivers hooks to them over signed HTTP.
modules.desc.forms: Contact form submissions: stored first, then mailed to the configured recipients. A feature of the public site module.
modules.desc.storage: Where uploads live: local disk or an S3-compatible bucket. A feature of the media module.
modules.desc.backups: Manual and scheduled local backups, restore previews and remote destinations. A feature of the admin module.
modules.desc.mail: SMTP delivery used by forms, the store and sign-in links. A core service published by the admin module.
modules.compat.manifest_unverified: manifest version; compatibility with this build is not verified
modules.compat.not_in_build: named in GORUN_ADDONS but not part of this build
modules.desc.identityai: AI identity suggestions (text only) written to the identity draft after a reviewed, approved request.
